data.title: Orešany – Slepý vrch, a drawing of the oldest Celtic hillfort
data.excerpt: Our collaborator Haden Sutton has made a drawing of the oldest Celtic hillfort in Slovakia, Slepý vrch, which lies on the boundary between the cadastral areas of the villages of Horné and Dolné Orešany. Celtic sherds still scattered over the artificially cut terraces around the hill show how intensively its interior was inhabited.

children.text: Our collaborator Haden Sutton has made for us a drawing of the oldest Celtic hillfort in Slovakia – Slepý vrch. The hillfort lies on the boundary between the cadastral areas of the villages of Horné and Dolné Orešany. The interior of the hillfort, formed mainly by settlement terraces, was intensively inhabited. This is still shown today by the abundant sherds of Celtic pottery scattered over the artificially cut terraces around the hill, on which the dwellings originally stood.
This drawing will form part of the information panel that our Hradiská civic association will place at the hillfort in Orešany.
